# External real-photo QA fixtures

These are public, licensed test photographs, not player uploads. No personal user photos are included.

- `dark-desk.jpg`: **Efnan Yılmaz**, [Dark photograph of a desk with a mug, notebook and a tablet](https://www.pexels.com/photo/dark-photograph-of-a-desk-with-a-mug-notebook-and-a-tablet-19653830/). Downloaded 2026-11-05, 1200 × 1800 portrait. Test objects: mug, tablet, notebook.
- `work-desk.jpg`: **Jep Gambardella**, [A laptop and headphones on the table](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-laptop-and-headphones-on-the-table-7690085/). Downloaded 2026-11-05, 1600 × 1067 landscape. Test objects: laptop, headphones, plant.

Both are used under the [Pexels license](https://www.pexels.com/license/). These fixture photographs are excluded from the source-code MIT grant; their original license applies. Tests manually position the faces on these objects; this is not a claim of automatic image recognition.
